items.evidence: Three-year Average ROA means the average "return on assets" for the three calendar years in the performance period.
Three-year Average Growth in Adjusted TBV means the average year-over-year percentage change in "adjusted tangible book value" for the three calendar years in the performance period.

equal_split.evidence: The awards are equally weighted with 50% based on ROA standards and 50% based on adjusted TBV growth standards.
